correctness.rationale: The greedy embedding cost is an exact if-and-only-if occurrence test. Explicitly derived first/internal/terminal single-deletion drops establish the local MAS language. Its exhaustive unique maximal-run decomposition yields rational series S and T and a formal odd-coefficient extraction; the bivariate rational law and all m,k follow algebraically. An independent literal brute test covers 1,398,078 target words for m=1..9 and a second stars-and-bars count matches coefficients for m=1..160. Infinite validity comes from the proof, not finite tests.

value.rationale: The canonical binary family (01)^m is minimally long for m-universality and sits at the smallest nonunary alphabet, giving a motivated natural boundary for qualitative MAS-vs-SAS separation. Exact length-by-length counts, an all-length local membership criterion, and a sharp exponential base reveal substantially more than the existing generic testing algorithms or numerical univariate sequence; the result does not assert an all-words extremum.
